Q: What is network functions virtualization?
Option1: The process of replacing dedicated network hardware devices with software-based services running on virtual machines
Option2: A method for encrypting cloud data
Option3: A tool for managing on-premises switches
Option4: A technology for physically separating network cables

Q: What is a virtual private cloud?
Option1: A logically isolated section of a public cloud that you can configure as if it were your own private network
Option2: A completely on-premises private data center
Option3: A public website hosted in the cloud
Option4: A service for delivering streaming media

Q: What is the main purpose of a network security group in cloud networking?
Option1: To control inbound and outbound traffic to cloud resources based on defined security rules
Option2: To manage usernames and passwords for all employees
Option3: To encrypt all storage volumes
Option4: To assign IP addresses automatically

Q: What is a network security list in cloud networking?
Option1: A set of virtual firewall rules that controls traffic to and from specific subnets or network interfaces
Option2: A list of users authorized to access the cloud
Option3: A catalog of network devices in the data center
Option4: A list of all domain names in use

Q: What is the purpose of a cloud internet gateway?
Option1: To provide a path for cloud resources to communicate with the public internet
Option2: To store backups in the cloud
Option3: To monitor and log all internal communications
Option4: To convert IPv4 addresses to IPv6 addresses

Q: What is a network address translation gateway in cloud networking?
Option1: A gateway that enables instances in a private cloud subnet to access the internet without exposing their private IP addresses
Option2: A device for physically connecting two networks
Option3: A firewall for blocking malware
Option4: A wireless access point for cloud networks

Q: What is a virtual private network in the context of cloud connectivity?

Option2: A dedicated physical cable between two sites
Option3: A backup connection for cloud services
Option4: A way to share files publicly

Q: What is a direct connect service in cloud networking?
Option1: A dedicated, private physical network connection from an on-premises network to a cloud provider
Option2: A satellite link for remote sites
Option3: A secure email transfer method
Option4: A service for delivering streaming media

Q: What is a public cloud deployment model?

Option2: A cloud environment used exclusively by a single organization
Option3: A hybrid of on-premises and cloud resources
Option4: A peer-to-peer network for file sharing

Q: What is a private cloud deployment model?
Option1: A cloud environment used exclusively by a single organization, either hosted on-site or by a third party
Option2: A public environment for multiple tenants
Option3: A dedicated section of a public cloud
Option4: A mix of public and private clouds

Q: What is a hybrid cloud deployment model?
Option1: A computing environment that combines public and private cloud resources with orchestration between them
Option2: A public network with encrypted access
Option3: A private network that uses virtualization
Option4: A local data center connected to a satellite link

Q: What is software as a service?

Option2: A model where the provider delivers only storage and networking
Option3: A model where the provider hosts only development tools
Option4: A licensing agreement for desktop software

Q: What is infrastructure as a service?

Option2: A model where only applications are delivered
Option3: A private network model for on-premises computing
Option4: A tool for managing hybrid cloud resources

Q: What is platform as a service?
Option1: A cloud model where the provider delivers hardware and software tools for application development over the internet
Option2: A model where only storage is delivered
Option3: A subscription to a web application
Option4: A hybrid deployment model

Option3: The process of encrypting cloud storage
Option4: The migration of workloads between clouds

Q: What does elasticity mean in cloud computing?
Option1: The automatic provisioning and releasing of resources to match workload changes in real time
Option2: The ability to survive a hardware failure
Option3: The encryption of all data at rest
Option4: The ability to run multiple operating systems

Q: What is multitenancy in cloud computing?

Option2: A setup where each customer has a dedicated physical server
Option3: A private network for one tenant only
Option4: A model where applications run without virtualization
